name: pe-sieve
description: Detect and dump malicious implants, shellcodes, hooks, and in-memory patches in running processes

pe-sieve.description: Scan a process for malicious implants and dump suspicious modules for analysis
pe-sieve.usage:
pe-sieve /pid 1234
pe-sieve /pid 1234 /shellc
pe-sieve /pid 1234 /hooks
pe-sieve /pid 1234 /dump_mode 2
pe-sieve /pid 1234 /out_dir C:\dumps
